rules.statement: The Land Registration Amendment Ordinance, No. 29 of 1917 applies to a lis pendens initiated but not concluded before the passing of the Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "That question is whether section 3 of the Land Registration Amendment Ordinance, No. 29 of 1917, as amended by Ordinance No. 21 of the following year, which declares that 'a lis pendens shall not bind a purchaser unless and until it is registered,' applies to a lis pendens initiated but not concluded before the passing of the Ordinance."
